references.text: Pilate's question about what he should do with Jesus, called the King of the Jews, resembles the situation in Matthew where Pilate asks a similar question to the crowd.
Pilate asks a question about Jesus, who is accused of being the King of the Jews, which mirrors the situation in Mark.
Pilate's offer to release Jesus at Passover, referred to as the King of the Jews, has parallels to Pilate's question in Mark.
The dialogue between Pilate and the Jews about Jesus, called the King of the Jews, shares similarities with Pilate's question in Mark.
